Definition: to commit adultery (usually of the female, and less often of simple fornication, rarely of involuntary ravishment); figuratively, to commit idolatry (the Jewish people being regarded as the spouse of Jehovah)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to commit fornication, be a harlot, play the harlot; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be a harlot, act as a harlot, commit fornication; 1a2) to commit adultery; 1a3) to be a cult prostitute; 1a4) to be unfaithful (to God) (fig.); 1b) (Pual) to play the harlot; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to commit adultery; 1c2) to force into prostitution; 1c3) to commit fornication
